AnalysisConfig.description: All scientific parameters. Its hash identifies a scientific computation.

basic_qc.description: Basic invalid-data checks shared by all methods.

windowing.description: Window length, step, and time span.

AnalysisConfig.title: AnalysisConfig

high_hz.description: Low-pass corner in Hz (None = no low-pass).
high_hz.title: High Hz

low_hz.description: High-pass corner in Hz (None = no high-pass).
low_hz.title: Low Hz

clip_fraction_of_full_scale.description: |x| >= this fraction of a declared full-scale value counts as clipped.
clip_fraction_of_full_scale.title: Clip Fraction Of Full Scale

flat_top_run_samples.description: Runs of >= this many identical samples at the record extreme count as clipped.
flat_top_run_samples.title: Flat Top Run Samples

sta_lta_enabled.description: Anti-trigger transient screening with STA/LTA on |x|.
sta_lta_enabled.title: Sta Lta Enabled

sta_lta_max.description: Window rejected if STA/LTA exceeds this anywhere inside it.
sta_lta_max.title: Sta Lta Max

sta_lta_min.description: Window rejected if STA/LTA falls below this anywhere inside it.
sta_lta_min.title: Sta Lta Min

show_alternate_method.description: Overlay the other method's mean curve.
show_alternate_method.title: Show Alternate Method

family_max_halfwidth_decades.description: Maximum family half-width around its KDE mode (log10 decades).
family_max_halfwidth_decades.title: Family Max Halfwidth Decades

kde_bandwidth_decades.description: Gaussian KDE bandwidth (log10 decades) for clustering window peaks into families.
kde_bandwidth_decades.title: Kde Bandwidth Decades

lower_edge_min_hv.description: Rising curve at the lowest usable frequency with H/V >= this flags lower_band_unresolved.
lower_edge_min_hv.title: Lower Edge Min Hv

mean_min_prominence_ratio.description: Discovery mean-curve local peak minimum prominence (amplitude ratio) for plausibility.
mean_min_prominence_ratio.title: Mean Min Prominence Ratio

min_discovery_windows.description: Minimum non-overlapping QC windows for discovery.
min_discovery_windows.title: Min Discovery Windows

min_recurrence.description: Minimum fraction of discovery windows with a peak inside the family.
min_recurrence.title: Min Recurrence

narrow_line_max_width_bins.description: Maximum width (FFT bins) of a narrow line.
narrow_line_max_width_bins.title: Narrow Line Max Width Bins

narrow_line_min_contrast_ratio.description: Raw-spectrum line contrast vs. its neighbourhood that counts as a narrow line.
narrow_line_min_contrast_ratio.title: Narrow Line Min Contrast Ratio

narrow_line_min_persistence.description: Fraction of windows in which the line must recur to be persistent.
narrow_line_min_persistence.title: Narrow Line Min Persistence

smoothing_sensitivity_bandwidth.description: Alternate (narrower) Konno-Ohmachi b used for the smoothing-sensitivity diagnostic.
smoothing_sensitivity_bandwidth.title: Smoothing Sensitivity Bandwidth

window_min_prominence_ratio.description: Per-window local peak minimum topographic prominence (amplitude ratio).
window_min_prominence_ratio.title: Window Min Prominence Ratio

fmax_hz.description: Upper limit of the peak search band (Hz).
fmax_hz.title: Fmax Hz

fmin_hz.description: Lower limit of the peak search band (Hz).
fmin_hz.title: Fmin Hz

bandpass.description: Optional record-level Butterworth filter. Off by default; recorded as a derived operation.

detrend.description: Per-window detrend applied after the per-window mean removal.
detrend.title: Detrend

response_correction.description: Instrument correction. 'scalar_sensitivity' divides each channel by its declared overall sensitivity (valid only inside the declared passband). Full deconvolution is not implemented.
response_correction.title: Response Correction

taper_alpha.description: Tukey taper fraction (total tapered fraction of the window).
taper_alpha.title: Taper Alpha

evaluate_sesame.description: Evaluate SESAME criteria (reporting only; never changes scientific results).
evaluate_sesame.title: Evaluate Sesame

calibration_profile.description: Optional offline calibration profile ID supplying stronger eligibility thresholds.
calibration_profile.title: Calibration Profile

extra_banks.description: Optional additional template families (e.g. 2DOF/3DOF bank IDs), reported separately.
extra_banks.title: Extra Banks

min_fft_bins_below_peak.description: Minimum original FFT bins inside [fp/2, fp).
min_fft_bins_below_peak.title: Min Fft Bins Below Peak

min_fft_bins_in_fit_band.description: Minimum original FFT bins inside [fp/2, 2 fp] for a rankable fit.
min_fft_bins_in_fit_band.title: Min Fft Bins In Fit Band

min_log_variance.description: Weighted variance of y below this makes R-squared undefined (unrankable).
min_log_variance.title: Min Log Variance

peak_interpolation.description: Peak estimator: 3-point parabola in (ln f, ln A), offset bounded to +/- half a grid step.
peak_interpolation.title: Peak Interpolation

r2_min.description: Eligibility requires R2_log strictly greater than this (0 = better than a constant).
r2_min.title: R2 Min

selection_mode.description: automatic: all greedy survivors; manual_top_n: first n (selection-conditional).
selection_mode.title: Selection Mode

template_bank.description: SDOF bank ID; 'auto' selects the shipped bank conditioned for this run's Konno-Ohmachi b if available.
template_bank.title: Template Bank

anti_alias_fraction.description: Frequencies above this fraction of Nyquist are invalid (anti-alias roll-off).
anti_alias_fraction.title: Anti Alias Fraction

grid_fmax_hz.description: Highest grid frequency (None = peak_search.fmax_hz * 4, capped by the anti-alias limit).
grid_fmax_hz.title: Grid Fmax Hz

grid_fmin_hz.description: Lowest grid frequency (None = peak_search.fmin_hz / 4, for SESAME [f0/4, 4 f0] checks).
grid_fmin_hz.title: Grid Fmin Hz

grid_points_per_decade.description: Anchored log grid f_i = 10**(i/P); P points per decade.
grid_points_per_decade.title: Grid Points Per Decade

horizontal_combination.description: rms: H = sqrt((N^2 + E^2)/2); geometric: H = sqrt(N*E).
horizontal_combination.title: Horizontal Combination

ko_support_rad.description: Konno-Ohmachi truncation: weights used where |b*log10(f/fc)| <= this value (3.0 matches hvsrpy).
ko_support_rad.title: Ko Support Rad

min_smoothing_bins.description: Minimum nonzero-frequency FFT bins inside the smoothing support for a valid grid point.
min_smoothing_bins.title: Min Smoothing Bins

processing_order.description: Horizontal combination of raw Fourier amplitudes, then Konno-Ohmachi smoothing of H and V (hvsrpy 2.x convention).
processing_order.title: Processing Order

vertical_floor_rel.description: A smoothed vertical amplitude below this fraction of the window's median smoothed vertical amplitude makes the bin invalid (no invented H/V).
vertical_floor_rel.title: Vertical Floor Rel

fdwra_n_std.description: FDWRA rejection half-width in lognormal standard deviations.
fdwra_n_std.title: Fdwra N Std

frequency_outlier_rejection.description: Optional frequency-domain window rejection after basic QC (can alter the peak distribution).
frequency_outlier_rejection.title: Frequency Outlier Rejection

tmax_s.description: Analyzed end, seconds after the first canonical sample (None = end).
tmax_s.title: Tmax S

tmin_s.description: Analyzed start, seconds after the first canonical sample (None = start).
tmin_s.title: Tmin S

adjacent_block_corr_max.description: If lag-1 correlation of block-mean features exceeds this, block length is doubled.
adjacent_block_corr_max.title: Adjacent Block Corr Max

irregular_block_lw_factor.description: Irregular sequences: original-time block length = factor * Lw (before dependence doubling).
irregular_block_lw_factor.title: Irregular Block Lw Factor

min_informative_blocks.description: Experimental guard: fewer informative blocks returns ci_not_estimable.
min_informative_blocks.title: Min Informative Blocks

regular_spacing_max_ratio.description: Retained sequence is 'regular' if max/min spacing between consecutive windows <= this.
regular_spacing_max_ratio.title: Regular Spacing Max Ratio

sensitivity_factors.description: Predeclared block-length multipliers reported as sensitivity (never chosen by width).
sensitivity_factors.title: Sensitivity Factors

sensitivity_width_ratio_limit.description: Band width ratio across sensitivity lengths above this marks ci_limited.
sensitivity_width_ratio_limit.title: Sensitivity Width Ratio Limit

step_s.description: Candidate window step dt in seconds; rounded to an integer sample count.
step_s.title: Step S

window_length_s.description: Window length Lw in seconds; rounded to an integer sample count (actual value recorded).
window_length_s.title: Window Length S

robustness_check.description: Plan run B (1.5 x Lw, other settings unchanged) before results are examined.
robustness_check.title: Robustness Check

robustness_lw_factor.description: Run B window-length multiplier (fixed in v1).
robustness_lw_factor.title: Robustness Lw Factor
